objective: Add configurable retry behavior to the existing HTTP client without changing its public request API.
work_unit: Implement the retry policy module and unit tests. Do not integrate the policy into the production HTTP client yet.
title: HTTP retry policy
current_work_state: The HTTP client already exists. Retry semantics have been agreed, but the standalone policy module has not been implemented.
deliverables: A retry policy module following the existing TypeScript conventions
Unit tests covering success, exhaustion, and non-retryable failures
host_owned_steps: Live services, databases, and network credentials
Git commit, branch creation, and repository push
acceptance_criteria: The policy retries only errors classified as retryable by the provided contract
The maximum-attempt count includes the initial attempt
Tests cover zero additional retries and exhausted retries
No production HTTP-client integration is included
non_goals: Changing the HTTP client's public API
architecture_context: The service is Node.js + TypeScript. Retry behavior belongs in src/http/retry and must depend on the existing error-classification contract rather than HTTP implementation details.
